title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: Detach procedure
entities.description: Procedure for detaching UE from network. Includes abnormal cases for CSG cell access and handover scenarios.

entities.name: DETACH REQUEST message
entities.description: NAS message sent by network to initiate detach procedure. May include EMM cause #25 for CSG authorization failures.

entities.name: DETACH ACCEPT message
entities.description: NAS message sent by network to accept detach request. Retransmitted during intra MME handover if undelivered.

entities.name: EMM cause #25
entities.description: EMM cause value indicating 'not authorized for this CSG'. Included in DETACH REQUEST when UE lacks valid CSG subscription.

entities.name: CSG cell with no valid subscription
entities.description: Abnormal condition where UE initiates detach in CSG cell without valid CSG subscription, excluding switch-off detach.

entities.name: Non-delivered NAS PDU due to handover
entities.description: Condition where DETACH ACCEPT message cannot be delivered due to intra MME handover, requiring retransmission.

entities.name: PDN connection for emergency bearer services
entities.description: Active PDN connection dedicated to emergency services. Preserved during IMSI detach in unauthorized CSG cells.

entities.name: Non-emergency EPS bearers
entities.description: EPS bearers not used for emergency services. Deactivated during IMSI detach in unauthorized CSG cells if emergency PDN is active.

relations.description: Detach procedure behavior is guarded by CSG subscription validity condition.
Detach procedure includes sending DETACH REQUEST message with EMM cause #25 for CSG authorization failure.
DETACH REESSAGE message contains EMM cause #25 IE when UE is not authorized for CSG.
DETACH ACCEPT message is sent if UE has active emergency PDN connection during IMSI detach in unauthorized CSG cell.
Active emergency PDN connection establishes deactivation of non-emergency EPS bearers during IMSI detach.
DETACH ACCEPT message retransmission is guarded by non-delivery due to intra MME handover condition.
